|strategy=My favorite strategy is to keep this in my hand until my opponent puts [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo){{!}}R2-D2]] on [[Red 5]] with [[Luke Skywalker]].(But it still works great when R2 is on any Starfighter w/out a permanent astromech).
